ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels to 35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity black region radiating from the fluke base to the trailing edge. High-intensity white lateral lobes featuring dense, high-frequency low-intensity stippling and mottling. A singular high-intensity vertical linear mark is located on the inner-right lobe segment.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel-based angle of approximately 52 degrees and deep penetration towards the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations along the trailing boundary; significant jagged peaks and raised textures (barnacle clusters) are localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a jagged, nearly horizontal trajectory towards the distal lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular high-contrast marks (dark outer rings with lighter centers) on the mid-section of the right lobe. Concentrated clusters of raised, textured anomalies (barnacles) at both distal fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical high-intensity (white) linear disruption on the inner right lobe. Several faint, non-aligned horizontal low-intensity (dark) linear marks across the white regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular scarring on the right lobe; prominent vertical white linear scar on the right lobe; calcified barnacle clusters at distal tip extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive and uniform 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern distributed across the entirety of the high-intensity fluke surface.
